name: @caiqueoak/flow
description: Readability-first, agent-agnostic software development workflow for coding agents.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node dist/entry.js schemas
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:coverage: c8 --all --extension .ts --extension .mts --include src/** --exclude src/**/tests/** --exclude src/**/*.test.* --exclude src/contracts/task.ts --exclude src/contracts/work-item.ts --exclude src/cli/command-metadata/definition.ts --reporter text --reporter lcov --reporter json-summary --reporter html --check-coverage --lines 80 --statements 80 --functions 80 --branches 70 npm test
scripts.test:unit: tsx --test src/artifacts/tests/unit/*.test.ts src/commands/*/tests/unit/*.test.ts src/execution/tests/unit/*.test.ts src/flow-project/tests/unit/*.test.ts src/package-assets/tests/unit/*.test.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write .github src scripts skills docs AGENTS.md package.json package-lock.json README.md eslint.config.js prettier.config.mjs tsconfig*.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check .github src scripts skills docs AGENTS.md package.json package-lock.json README.md eslint.config.js prettier.config.mjs tsconfig*.json
scripts.verify: npm run check:runtime && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run pack:check && npm run test:package
